description: Cloud Storage bucket for object data.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Must be globally unique across GCP.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The Google Cloud Storage location or region.

fields.label: Storage Class
fields.help: The Storage Class of the new bucket.

fields.label: Uniform Bucket Level Access
fields.help: Disables per-object ACLs in favour of IAM. Recommended.

fields.label: Force Destroy
fields.help: Allows terraform destroy to delete a bucket that still holds objects.
